start.welcome:
👋 Hi! I'm a Telegram → Notion bridge.

Send me text or a link and I'll save it as a Notion page.

First, connect your Notion integration via Settings.
start.already_connected: ✅ Notion is connected. Send text or a link to create a page.
settings.title: ⚙️ Settings
connect.ask_token:
🔑 Send your Notion Integration Token.

Create one at https://www.notion.so/my-integrations and share your database with it.
connect.ask_database: 🗂 Now send the Notion Database ID (or paste the database URL).
connect.invalid_token: ❌ Invalid Notion token. Check the Integration Secret and try again.
connect.invalid_database_id: ❌ That doesn't look like a valid Database ID or URL.
connect.database_not_found: ❌ Database not found. Share the database with your integration and try again.
connect.no_access: ❌ No access to this database. Open the DB → ••• → Connections → add your integration.
connect.network_error: 📡 Network error talking to Notion. Please try again later.
connect.notion_api_error: ❌ Notion API error. Please try again or check integration permissions.
content.empty: Send some text or a link to save.
